lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling, my name is Alex. How can I help?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hello. I would like to delete my account and remove my personal data please.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I can help with that. May I ask why you want to close the account?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I just do not use the service anymore.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I understand. I have submitted the request to delete your account. You will get a confirmation email within twenty four hours.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay, that is fine. Thank you.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you for being a customer. Goodbye.
